selection.purpose: Strict product candidate set for review and merge with the existing catalogue.
selection.canonicalCounting: One record per semantic material key. Open Food Facts aliases and explicit spelling/form duplicates are retained for search but never counted as separate materials.
exclusions: E-numbers, additives, vitamins, minerals, supplements, functional proteins/fibers/gums, cultures, enzymes, flavoring/aroma entries, and chemical sugar classes.
Percentage-fat, low-fat, organic, no-sugar, GMO, hydrogenated, UHT, pasteurized, modifier-only and processing-state variants.
Brands, packaging, meat, fish, shellfish, roe and animal cuts.
Inexact mixtures or alternatives containing 'and'/'or', except where retained as a source alias rather than a counted material.
Duplicate spelling/form records such as mint/mint leaf/fresh mint and whisky/whiskey/whiskeys.
